BEST_TIE_BREAK: lowest portfolio SHA-256 among all exact optima of the best count
ELITE_POOL_RULE: canonical v5/v6/v7 tickets that are neither frozen nor removed (group B)

KERNEL.EXTENSION: wide.py: two-word (128-bit) residual winner masks so pools of 65..128 tickets feed the unchanged branch and bound
KERNEL.REUSED: engine b470fbfd: exact global scorer and identities, global pool assembly, _TieSearch branch and bound (submodular remaining-slot bound only)

PARITY_DEFINITION: per destroy set, canonical recounts (official any-prize evaluator over all draws) of two real repaired portfolios - the set's lowest-SHA optimum and a hashed repair using two high-word pool tickets - against the two-word kernel
PEAK_MEMORY_DEFINITION: max ru_maxrss over every sweep process (per set row) and the terminal process
PROVEN_OPTIMALITY_SCOPE: each destroy set's optimum is proven within its declared repair pool only

SAMPLE_STRATIFICATION.ALLOCATION: min(size, 8) per non-empty stratum, then the rest proportional to stratum size (largest remainder, ties by stratum key, capped at the stratum size)
SAMPLE_STRATIFICATION.BINNING: OVERLAP and ORPHAN_NUMBERS use value thresholds t1=V[N//3], t2=V[2N//3] of the sorted values V over all C(20,5) sets: bin 0 if v<=t1, bin 1 if v<=t2, else bin 2
SAMPLE_STRATIFICATION.EVALUATION_ORDER: ascending sha256(f'{seed}:order:{positions}'), so any prefix is hash-random

FEATURES.INDEX_SPLIT: destroyed positions in 0..9 (first half of the START order): {0,1}->0, {2,3}->1, {4,5}->2 (index combination)
FEATURES.ORPHAN_NUMBERS: count of numbers 1..49 that appear in the START but in no ticket kept after destroying the set (number-frequency profile)
FEATURES.OVERLAP: sum over the 10 ticket pairs inside the destroy set of |Ti & Tj| (ticket overlap summary)

SAMPLE_STRATIFICATION.INPUT: START portfolio tickets and their positional order only

WALL_SECONDS_DEFINITION: campaign start timestamp to completion of the canonical recount (includes any interruption between resumes)
